title: Supplement to the fourth, fifth and sixth editions of the Encyclopaedia Britannica - Volume 4 - EB.13
text: An argand oil lamp with a burner three-fourths of an inch diameter, we have found to consume 60 grains of the best spectactical oil in one hour, when giving the light of 3J candles of the size above specified. Five thousand graines of oil will, therefore, the the same quantity of light that 1lb of tallow does, and valuing it at 3s. 6d. per gallon, the cost will be, with an allowance for wicks and trouble of trimming, about 6jd.
